name: data-grid
title: DataGrid
description: A virtualized table: only the rows in view (plus a small overscan) are in the DOM, so tens of thousands of rows scroll smoothly. Rows are a fixed height (the windowing needs it); a spacer sizes the scroll area to the full list. For a short, static table use <Table>; reach for this when the row count is large.
